modmenu.descriptionTranslation.artmap_gr:
Client-side guides for painting on 32×32 ArtMap canvases.

G toggles the subtle gray pixel grid.
F toggles cross marks inside the four central pixels.

The grid and crosses work independently. Keys can be reassigned in Controls. Guides are visible only to you and never become part of the painting.

Author: ani_kaa (Vanilla Game)

N toggles pink section guides. Choose 2×2, 4×4, 8×8, 16×16 or 32×32 pixel sections in this mod's Mod Menu settings.

Source code: https://github.com/Vanilla-Game/ArtMap-Grid
